name: InstantX/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora-Diffusers
summary: InstantX 提供 Turbo LoRA 适配器，可在 Diffusers 中复用 MiniMax-H3 基础模型，从文本生成视频。模型卡说明，当时已发布的 Diffusers 版本尚不支持 MiniMax-H3，需从 main 分支安装 Diffusers，并安装 PEFT。

InstantX provides a Turbo LoRA adapter for generating video from text with MiniMax-H3 in Diffusers. It reuses the MiniMax-H3 base model. To get started, the model card directs users to install Diffusers from its main branch and add PEFT, because the released Diffusers builds documented there lack MiniMax-H3 support.
